title: Setlist For BTS World Tour Arirang, Including Mikrokosmos, I Need U, And Surprise Songs (Updated October 31, 2026) - FZINE Singapore
text:
Setlist For BTS World Tour Arirang, Including Mikrokosmos, I Need U, And Surprise Songs (Updated October 31, 2026) | FZINE Singapore FASHION CULTURE BEAUTY WATCHES AND JEWELLERY PEOPLE CAM PARTIES Culture Here’s The Setlist For BTS’ World Tour Arirang Comeback Concert
 From decade-old BTS classics, to hidden tracks, here’s the entire set list for BTS’ world tour.
 BigHit Music and Netflix By  Lucy Lauron ,  31 Oct 2026 
 In Seoul, South Korea, BTS finally kicked off their first world tour in seven years: BTS World Tour Arirang. It’s the first of the septet’s 34-city tour across five continents — and it’s already projected to earn at least US$2 billion in ticket sales and merchandise. BTS is, after all, arguably the biggest boy band in the world.
 Under the pouring rain, BTS performed a set of 23 tracks, including the entire catalogue of their latest album, Arirang (save for One More Night and No. 29 ) as well as some of their iconic throwback songs, like a decade-old BTS classic I Need U , and fan-favourite Mikrokosmos. To say that fans were in a tizzy would be an understatement. Scroll on for the entire setlist of the group’s world tour.
 You might also like: A sneak peek into Singapore’s BTS ARMY scene and how they celebrated the group’s first live comeback performance.

 What surprise songs have BTS performed so far for the ‘World Tour Arirang ’?
 At each tour stop, BTS plays two surprise throwback tracks that aren’t on the Arirang album. Here are the surprise songs that the group has done so far:
 Seoul, South Korea (April 9-12, 2026): Mikrokosmos & I Need U, Take Two & DNA , Spring Day & Run 
 Tokyo, Japan (April 17 & 18, 2026): Save Me & Crystal Snow, Dope & For You

 When is BTS coming to Singapore for ‘World Tour Arirang ’?
 BTS will be performing in Singapore on December 17, 19, 20 and 22, 2026 at the Singapore National Stadium.
 Are tickets for BTS’ 2026 Singapore Concert sold out?
 All four days of their Singapore stop have sold out. There have not been any additional ticket sales announced after the initial ticket sales in June, but keep an eye out for official updates on Weverse and the tour’s official website just in case.
 Which Southeast Asian countries will BTS be performing in?
 Other than Singapore, BTS will also be making stops in Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia and the Philippines for ‘World Tour Arirang ’.
